info.title: AI Software Project Health & Risk Analyzer
info.description: Backend API for analysing software project health and risk.

post.description:
Create a new user account.

- **name**: Full name of the user
- **email**: Must be unique
- **password**: Plain-text (hashed before storage; never stored in plain text)

post.summary: Sign in and receive a JWT token
post.description:
Authenticate with email + password.

Returns a Bearer token on success.
Returns **401** for invalid credentials (intentionally vague to prevent
user enumeration).

Stateless logout — the client must discard the token.

For token revocation, a server-side denylist (e.g. Redis) can be added
later without changing this interface.

get.description:
Returns the authenticated user's profile.

Requires: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's notification preferences
get.description:
Returns the current user's notification preferences.
If preferences have not been explicitly saved yet, returns default preferences.

patch.summary: Update the authenticated user's notification preferences
patch.description:
Partially or fully update notification preferences.
Preserves existing preference values when omitted in the request.
Validates extra fields via extra='forbid'.

get.description:
Retrieve all projects where the authenticated user is an owner or member.
Unowned legacy projects without verified ownership or membership are excluded.

schema.title: Response List Projects Endpoint Api Projects Get

post.description:
Create a new project. The authenticated caller becomes the project owner
and initial member.

get.description:
Retrieve a specific project by its ID.
The caller must be a verified owner or member.

patch.description:
Update project details and configuration (name, description, repo_url, default_branch).
Only the verified project owner can update project configuration.

post.summary: Archive a project (Owner or Admin only)
post.description:
Mark a project as archived.
An archived project becomes strictly read-only: data synchronization and configuration
mutations are disabled, while existing data and historical telemetry remain readable.

parameters.name: id

schema.description: ID of the project to archive
schema.title: Id

parameters.description: ID of the project to archive

delete.summary: Soft-delete a project (Owner or Admin only)
delete.description:
Soft-delete a project and cascade inactive status across all associated collections.
Does not physically delete project or telemetry documents, preserving historical audit trails.

parameters.name: id

schema.description: ID of the project to soft-delete
schema.title: Id

parameters.description: ID of the project to soft-delete

post.summary: Connect a GitHub repository to a project
post.description:
Connect a GitHub repository to a project by updating its repo_url and default_branch.
Only the project owner or admin can connect a repository.

get.summary: List all connected repositories for current user's projects
get.description: List all projects that have a connected repository accessible by the current user.

schema.title: Response List Repositories Endpoint Api Repositories Get

get.summary: Fetch remote branches for a GitHub repository
get.description:
Query GitHub API from the backend server to discover active branches.
Uses GITHUB_TOKEN if configured in server environment to avoid rate limits.

Retrieve stored contributors for a project.

Requires authentication and verified project membership.

post.description:
Sync contributors from GitHub.

Requires authentication and verified project membership.

get.description:
Retrieve stored commits for a project.

Requires authentication and verified project membership.

post.description:
Retrieve commits from GitHub and persist them.

Requires authentication and verified project membership.

get.description:
Retrieve the issues stored for a project (never calls GitHub).

Requires authentication and verified project membership.

schema.title: Response Get Issues Api Projects  Project Id  Issues Get

post.description:
Fetch all open and closed issues (not pull requests) from GitHub
and store them with one batch upsert.

Requires an admin or project-manager role and project membership.
The request body is optional; the project's configured repository
is used unless a matching repo_url is supplied.

get.description:
Retrieve the pull requests stored for a project (never calls GitHub).

Requires authentication and verified project membership.

parameters.name: state

schema.description: Optional filter: open, closed, or merged.
schema.title: State

parameters.description: Optional filter: open, closed, or merged.

schema.title: Response Get Pull Requests Api Projects  Project Id  Prs Get

post.description:
Fetch all open, closed, and merged pull requests from GitHub and
store them with upsert.

Requires an admin or project-manager role and project membership.
The request body is optional; the project's configured repository is
used unless a matching repo_url is supplied.

get.description:
Retrieve the milestones stored for a project (never calls GitHub).

Requires authentication and verified project membership.

schema.title: Response Get Milestones Api Projects  Project Id  Milestones Get

post.description:
Fetch all open and closed milestones from GitHub and store them
with upsert.

Requires an admin or project-manager role and project membership.
The request body is optional; the project's configured repository is
used unless a matching repo_url is supplied.

Projects without milestones return a success response with
status "no_milestones" and message "Insufficient milestone data".

get.description:
Retrieve configured health and risk thresholds for a project.
If the project has not configured custom thresholds, sensible system defaults
are returned (e.g. stale PR > 48h, stale issue > 14 days, workload imbalance ratio > 3.0).
Requires the caller to be a member or owner of the project (or global admin).

put.description:
Update project health & risk thresholds.
Restricted to project owner, admin, or lead.
Validates input bounds and returns clear error messages on invalid values.

get.description: Returns composite 0-100 health score, aggregated status (Good / Caution / At Risk), and active flags.
Returns granular indicators (bottlenecks, workload, stale issues, schedule risk) with weights and evidence, along with advisory engineering recommendations.

post.summary: Run the LangGraph V2 analysis and persist a validated status report
Run a schedule now and stamp its lastRun

post.description:
Deactivates a user account.
Restricted to system administrators.
Sets is_active: false in the user document, immediately invalidating any active JWT sessions.

parameters.name: id

schema.description: The ID of the user to deactivate
schema.title: Id

parameters.description: The ID of the user to deactivate

get.description:
Return a paginated list of all platform users.
Supports full-text search over *name* and *email* fields
and optional filtering by ``is_active``.

patch.description:
Change the role of an existing user.

- Allowed values: ``admin``, ``project_manager``, ``developer``.
- An admin **cannot** demote their own account.
- A role-change audit record is created on success.

post.description:
Re-activate a previously deactivated user.

- An admin **cannot** activate/deactivate their own account
  (self-protection guard applies to both transitions).

Deactivate a user account.

- An admin **cannot** deactivate their own account.
- Deactivated users receive **401 Unauthorized** on every subsequent
  authenticated request (enforced in ``get_current_user``).

get.description: Return the most recent platform audit events, newest-first.

schema.title: Response Fetch Audit Logs Api Admin Audit Logs Get

post.summary: Submit an appeal against a health flag
post.description: Allow a project developer to appeal a currently generated health flag.

get.description: Developers see their own appeals; project managers see all project appeals.

schema.title: Response List Appeals Api Projects  Project Id  Appeals Get

patch.description: Allow a project manager (team lead) who belongs to the project to review.

post.description: Receives GitHub webhook events, verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature, and synchronizes data.

PRResponse.title: PRResponse

userId.title: Userid
userId.description: User ID of the project member

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: The specific observed condition or bottleneck this recommendation addresses.

action.title: Action
action.description: Actionable, pragmatic engineering suggestion for team leads or engineers.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why this action is suggested based on computed metrics and project health.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Priority level: LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH.

target_role.title: Target Role
target_role.description: Stakeholder group primarily concerned (e.g. 'Team Lead', 'Project Manager', 'Reviewer').

is_advisory.title: Is Advisory
is_advisory.description: Affirmation that this recommendation is strictly advisory and not an automated action.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Recommendations are advisory. Final decisions remain with the engineering team.

RecommendationSchema.title: RecommendationSchema
RecommendationSchema.description:
Schema for actionable advisory engineering recommendations.
Enforces the advisory disclaimer principle (system does not make automated decisions).

stale_pr_hours.title: Stale Pr Hours
stale_pr_hours.description: Hours after which an open PR with no activity is flagged as stale (1 to 720 hours / 30 days).

stale_issue_days.title: Stale Issue Days
stale_issue_days.description: Days after which an open issue with no activity is flagged as stale (1 to 365 days).

workload_imbalance_ratio.title: Workload Imbalance Ratio
workload_imbalance_ratio.description: Ratio of highest contributor activity to team median before workload imbalance is flagged (1.01 to 20.0).

bus_factor_threshold.title: Bus Factor Threshold
bus_factor_threshold.description: Proportion of total commits by a single contributor that flags a bus factor risk (0.01 to 1.0, e.g. 0.60 for 60%).

ThresholdConfig.title: ThresholdConfig
ThresholdConfig.description: Configuration model holding the project health & risk thresholds.

is_customized.title: Is Customized
is_customized.description: True if thresholds have been explicitly customized, False if using system defaults.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Timestamp when thresholds were last updated (UTC).

ThresholdsResponse.title: ThresholdsResponse
ThresholdsResponse.description: Response returned when querying or updating project thresholds.

stale_pr_hours.title: Stale Pr Hours
stale_pr_hours.description: Hours after which a PR is stale (1 to 720 hours).

stale_issue_days.title: Stale Issue Days
stale_issue_days.description: Days after which an issue is stale (1 to 365 days).

workload_imbalance_ratio.title: Workload Imbalance Ratio
workload_imbalance_ratio.description: Ratio of highest contributor activity to median (1.01 to 20.0).
